_readme: Canonical owner/entity registry, added 2026-09-24 to fix multi-club ownership detection on /sports/owners and /sports/valuations. Problem: lib/teamOwners.ts groups franchises into a portfolio purely by an exact-string match on owner_key from scripts/data/team-owners-seed.json. When the SAME person or holding company controls two clubs under two DIFFERENT display names -- e.g. Wes Edens is 'Wes Edens' at the Milwaukee Bucks but part of 'V Sports' at Aston Villa -- the two rows land in separate portfolios and the site shows no multi-club link, even though the seed's own prose notes the connection. This registry is the fix: each entity lists every alias owner_key it appears under (for CONTROL roles, which lib/ownerRegistry.ts folds into one portfolio) plus every club it holds, control or minority (used to badge minority cross-links that the portfolio grouping intentionally does not merge, per the seed's one-control-entity-per-franchise rule). Read lib/ownerRegistry.ts for how this is consumed. Entities already correctly unified by a shared owner_key (Kroenke, Friedkin Group, City Football Group, Black Knight, Fenway Sports Group core clubs, Glazer family, Josh Harris/HBSE, Woody Johnson) are still documented here so this file is the complete audit trail Ashwin asked for, not just the one broken case.
